title: This Frog Turns See-Through When It Sleeps
description: Glass frogs hide almost all their red blood cells in their liver while sleeping, becoming nearly invisible.

scenes.text: There is a frog that can make itself almost see-through. It is called the glass frog.
scenes.subject: frog
scenes.say: [whispers] There is a frog that can make itself almost see-through. It is called the glass frog.

scenes.text: Glass frogs live in rainforests in Central and South America, and the skin on their bellies is clear.
scenes.subject: frog
scenes.say: Glass frogs live in rainforests in Central and South America, and the skin on their bellies is clear.

scenes.text: Scientists found that when they sleep, these frogs pack most of their red blood cells into their liver.
scenes.subject: frog
scenes.say: [curious] Scientists found that when they sleep, these frogs pack most of their red blood cells into their liver.

scenes.text: With their red blood tucked away, they become two to three times more transparent, and much harder for predators to spot.
scenes.subject: frog
scenes.say: [excited] With their red blood tucked away, they become two to three times more transparent, and much harder for predators to spot.

scenes.text: Its own built in invisibility trick. Follow for more weird facts.
